messages:
ash: Quick review of the 'inkwell' dark theme mock. A few small but noisy issues: legend dots disappear on thumbnails, code snippets blend into card background, and the theme toggle tooltip is confusing. Screenshot: https://mock.link/inkwell.png :mag:
pete: I noticed the legend problem too. At 10px the dot is basically invisible. Proposal: increase stroke to 1px, and nudge dot fill lighter by ~12% luminance.
lucy: Code block spacing is 8px right now. Bump to 12px and use slightly warmer code text (#e7f1ff). For the background try #0c1420 so snippets stand apart.
ash: Accessibility callout: some chart series are ~3:1 contrast at small sizes. Primary series should be >=4.5:1. Can we reserve brighter accents for primary paths?
pete: For gradients, try hard stop at 28% instead of 50% so midtones read better. Also desaturate area fills slightly to avoid muddy mixes when multiple series overlap.
design-bot: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/512 (inkwell: charts + code contrast). CI: 1 visual snapshot flagged (legend dots).
lucy: Copy tweak: change toggle tooltip to "Switch light/dark theme" and move "Reduced motion" to a separate control under Accessibility.
ash: Action items: pete adjust gradients and dot stroke; lucy update code vars & copy; ash to run contrast audit after PR merges. Target: staging tomorrow.
pete: I'll push a quick storybook patch today. :rocket:
